lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-intensity circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill region, organized into approximately 6-7 identifiable horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Thin vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes where the spots are centered within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge (carina) is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance highlight on the dorsal edge and a cast shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) swimming near the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin and human silhouettes visible in the upper background of the water column.
